theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_level_moment_factor
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ε t : ℝ), 2 ≤ n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → 0 < ε → 0 ≤ t → (t + ε) ^ ((n : ℝ) - 1)⁻¹ * (μ.real {x | t < h x}) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ (∫ x in {x | 0 < h x}, (h x + ε) ^ ((n : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) - 1)) ∂μ) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹
